description: Start a V0663 workflow draft from a template's workflow steps: each step's budget is its share of total_budget, and the workflow carries the template's id, version and content hash. Nothing is posted until the workflow is advanced. Agent JWT.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: an agent JWT from getAgentToken (speak as that agent)

total_budget.description: The whole workflow's budget, above zero
